reviews.t: It's not like a Water-Pik, if that's what you are after
reviews.x: Bought this for travel use on our trip to South America recently. It worked well and doesn't leak, but it's not the same as a Water-Pik. Instead of the pulsating water action one would expect, it sends out a continuous stream. Because of this, it doesn't clean as thoroughly as a Water-Pik does but it's definitely better than other things if one just wants to do a quick cleaning to dislodge food between the teeth. Reservoir is quite small and only holds enough water for 15-20 seconds of cleaning.

This thing is horrible!  It squirts water out so fast it gags you.  It made the biggest mess in my bathroom.  I bought this for my son and he couldn’t even use it because it was so uncomfortable.  I couldn’t imagine how awful it was until I tried it myself!  I was gagging and I couldn’t get it to shut off and it was spraying all over my bathroom.  How this got the good reviews I will never know!  Use your money and buy the brand name!

I needed to get a replacement water floss and came across this one. I decided to get this one base on the stars and price. The one thing I dislike from this brand compared to the other brand I had is the water pressure. Just wish it was a little more stronger. Also the water runs out fast from the reservoir.

Better off saving up for one that’s a little more money. I feel like I’ve wasted 20 something dollars here. First of all there’s one speed and that is jet plane it was so fast it threw the little piece on top of the tube and I’m hoping it didn’t break my bridge . Would not recommend

The water flosser works great after learning how to use it.  However, one of the rubber pieces on one of the heads came out in my daughters mouth when it hit her tooth.  So now we are down a head and it was her favorite one.  😕 Haven’t found where to get a replacement head.

Love the item but you have to beware to make sure you take the attachment out of the device because it has a tendency to break off inside of the device and it's very hard to get out. I need to order more attachments.

reviews.t: I would Not recommend this product!
reviews.x: Very small water jet power, small water container. This floss only make slight oral cavity rinse without any proper cleaning. Add literally $10 more and you can buy a much more powerful device.
The design is nice, the water pressure is too low and the water tank is way too small. If you dont have tight spaces in your teeth this may be great for you. It didnt do it for me
There is only one pressure level and it is very high. The amount of water released into your mouth is uncontrollable. My experience was a bit overwhelming.
I read all the reviews about the pressure being too strong and thought I could handle it. Was wrong. Feel like this probably does more harm than good.
This flosser isn't over priced and is easy to use. I noticed the difference the first use.
Too little water capacity. On low power, the unit gives maybe 20 seconds of usage.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the water reservoir too small and requiring frequent refills during use.
Several reviewers say the water pressure is weak or insufficient for effective flossing between teeth.
Some reviewers report the device is easy to use and charge, and consider it good value for the price.
A few reviewers complain about the water stream being too forceful or messy, causing gagging or splashing.
Some reviewers mention issues with attachments or parts breaking or coming off.
